[[Kristoffir Roi]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Brauer Academy}}

==Dialogue==
:''"These [[Dredge]] roaming the forest as of late are very unique. They behave unlike any creature I've ever seen before! I'm studying them so that I might write a tome or two about their species, but they are so skittish that it has been difficult to acquire any specimens for examinations. Fetch me 5 Dredge Incisors to aid my research, and I'll part with this:"''

==Trivia==
*This NPC was named after one of the ArenaNet alpha testers, Christopher "Dynatos" Roy, who helped to compile the information included in the Guild Wars: Factions Official Guidebook.
